_comment: ICD-9-CM code prefixes (no dots) used to label outcomes in the MIMIC-III (BIDMC) external cohort, from eTable 2 of the paper's appendix. A diagnosis matches an outcome if its code starts with a listed prefix. Death ('death occurring after birth') is taken from ADMISSIONS.HOSPITAL_EXPIRE_FLAG. Pulmonary hypertension is listed in eTable 2 but was not among the 10 outcomes reported for the external cohort.
